name: Weblium
summary: Template-based website builder for small businesses, with an AI assistant, lead capture forms and integrations, and an online store, blog and multilingual pages on the Business plan.
best_for: small businesses and freelancers who want a template-based site with forms and integrations for one business, at a low yearly price
skip_if: you need many sites under one subscription, a large content site on Starter, or full design and code control
honest_knock: Starter caps a site at 10 pages and 5 GB of bandwidth and has no blog or online store; those need Business. Every subscription covers one website, and moving to a cheaper plan only works after the current term ends. The Free plan is limited to 3 pages, 100 MB storage and 100 MB bandwidth, and its card carries a '60 days' label the page does not explain. We have not used Weblium ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month billed yearly ($132 a year), one website
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-08 on weblium.com/pricing in a browser render, USD; the FAQ says all prices are in USD) Three plans, each for one website. Free has the editor, 300+ templates, mobile optimisation, free icons and photos and the Evo AI assistant, with up to 3 pages per site, 100 MB storage and 100 MB bandwidth and no credit card; the Free card also carries a '60 days' label that the page does not explain. Starter is $11 a month billed annually ($132 a year) or $16 billed monthly ($192 a year): advanced SEO settings, lead capture tools, advanced design, integrations and custom code, up to 10 pages per site, 3 GB media storage, 5 GB bandwidth and no Weblium branding. Business, marked most popular, is $17.50 a month annually ($210 a year) or $25 monthly ($300 a year) and adds the online store, the blog, multilingual sites in up to 5 languages, up to 500 pages, 10 GB storage and 20 GB bandwidth. Starter and Business have a 14-day free trial without a card. Each subscription covers one website; bundles for 5, 10 or 15 sites save 25-40%. Annual plans include a free domain for the first year. You can upgrade any time, but to move to a lower plan you cancel auto-renewal and buy the new plan after the current one ends. If a renewal payment fails, paid features stay on for 5 days and the site then drops to Free. Weblium Studio builds sites for you from $300, and a white-label version for agencies starts at $48 a month.

free_plan_evidence: The Free plan is limited to 3 pages, 100 MB storage and 100 MB bandwidth, and its card carries a '60 days' label the page does not explain.

compare_with.name: Webflow
compare_with.why: Webflow is in our dossiers too and gives designers far more control over layout, CMS and code, at higher prices. Weblium is the simpler template builder: cheaper per site, but with page caps and the blog and store only on Business.
